name: abracadabrax-background-music-generator-v2
description: Describe a mood and get an original instrumental track for a video, podcast, ad, game, stream or study session, produced in your Abracadabrax account.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a mood and get an original instrumental track to sit under a video, a podcast, an ad, a game, a livestream or a study session.

The plugin prepares a draft with what the music is for, the genre, the tempo, the length and the model, and shows the credits it will use. When you confirm, Abracadabrax produces the track and ChatGPT returns the link to the audio file.

For creators, streamers and teams who need music without licensing hassles.

Limitations: new instrumental tracks from text only. It does not remix, extend or split existing recordings or add vocals. Producing uses credits of the user's Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
defaultPrompt: Calm lo-fi background music for studying, 2 minutes
Upbeat corporate acoustic track for a product demo video, 60 seconds
Dark ambient loop for a horror game menu screen

positive.prompt: Calm lo-fi background music for studying, 2 minutes. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: An instrumental draft of 120 seconds, the model and the credits it will use. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: Upbeat corporate acoustic track for a product demo video, 60 seconds. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: An instrumental draft of 60 seconds for a video and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: Dark ambient loop for a horror game menu screen. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: An instrumental draft with a dark ambient style for a game and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A 30-second calm piano track for a meditation video. Generate it now and send me the link when it's ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The draft is prepared, then one job starts in the signed-in Abracadabrax account and the credits shown are charged once; get_song_job reports the progress and, when completed, returns the absolute audio URL and the Abracadabrax link. The panel shows the result.

positive.prompt: 60 seconds of upbeat ukulele music for a travel vlog. Prepare it, then make it 30 seconds instead. Don't generate it yet.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_background_music, then update_song_project or prepare_background_music again
positive.expected_behavior: A draft is prepared, then it holds the 30-second length, either updated or prepared again, with the credits for the new settings. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

negative.prompt: Remix this MP3 I uploaded into a lo-fi version.

negative.description: Adding music to a video file
negative.prompt: Put background music under the video file I attached and export it.
Split the vocals and the drums from my track.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing uses credits of the user's existing Abracadabrax account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: prepare a draft, produce it in the connected Abracadabrax account and get the audio link back in the conversation.
